title: Turtle in Cosmic Egg
description: A large cracked white egg rests on rocky ground, its shell covered in green slime. Inside sits a green turtle with glowing yellow symbols on its shell, from which purple and green tentacles emerge, supporting two giant dragonflies with pink and red wings. In the background a purple castle sits atop a hill beneath a swirling rainbow vortex sky filled with smaller dragonflies.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a giant cracked white egg on rocky ground with green slime dripping down its shell. A mystical green turtle with glowing yellow symbols on its shell is emerging from the egg. Long purple and green tentacles rise from the turtle, lifting two enormous detailed dragonflies with pink and red wings. In the background a dark purple castle sits on a hill. The sky is a swirling colorful cosmic vortex of red, pink, yellow, and teal with glowing orbs and many smaller dragonflies flying around. Vibrant colors, intricate details, psychedelic atmosphere.
